results.title: China is back in the bull semen market, but only the best will do
results.description: China imports bull semen as the genetic quality of its domestic cattle is lower than that overseas.

results.title: USTR Greer tells EU that loan to Airbus threatens trade truce on aircraft financing
results.description: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told the European Union on Monday that a lack of information about its record-breaking loan to Airbus threatens a delicate transatlantic trade truce including on financing large civil aircraft LCA projects In a statement Greer expressed frustration that despite ongoing requests his office has received no details about the 34 billion loan made in June from the European Investment Bank the EUs official lending arm

results.title: Medicinal cannabis worker awarded more than $242,000 after Employment Court challenge
results.description: The Employment Court increased Alexis López’s award after finding shares could not lawfully substitute for three months of wages.

results.title: Mankind Pharma shares jump 8% as Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 716 crore
results.description: Mankind Pharma shares jumped nearly 8% after the company reported a 38% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 716 crore. Revenue grew 17%, supported by domestic and export growth, while EBITDA margins expanded 210 basis points.
